title: Giving addition another name
description: You can bind a function value and call it through its new name.

steps.description: define binds add to the value of +. You are naming the addition procedure itself.
This expression supplies + as a value rather than calling it with operands. add now refers to that procedure.

steps.question: What does (add 3 2) compute?
steps.answer: It calls the addition procedure with 3 and 2 and returns 5.

steps.description: You see 5 in the output. The function call uses add in operator position.
